candidate_selection: Already fixed to existing NPZ; no refit, candidate promotion, method changes or parameter tuning after outcome release.
target: Sum positive noncancelled recorded Quantity; retain positive processing/returned records. Deduplicate exact original source rows, assert Transaction_ID has no conflicting nonidentical rows.
exposure: Use ALL deduplicated source transactions, including cancelled/nonpositive rows, for observed Store_ID/date and store-week presence. Original source columns define duplicate identity; no synthetic lineage columns in row equality. Entire unobserved store-week is excluded identically for both models; no true-demand/complete-capture claim.
population: All same336 frozen Product_ID/Store_ID keys per four primary target windows. Score equal weight per eligible key/window. Report all exclusions and eligible fraction of1344.
numeric_policy: Parse frozen forecast decimal text and source quantities as Decimal with at least50digit precision. Compare paired total absolute errors directly (same denominator), without rounding or epsilon. Equal/tie is not improvement. Display rounding does not govern selection.
mvp_comparison_rule: candidate_absolute_error_sum < baseline_absolute_error_sum; report relative MAE difference, bias, each week, coverage and descriptive uncertainty. No invented5percent threshold or business-value/cost claim.
secondary_scope: December29-31/monthwide/daily/lead-plus-review diagnostics must not replace primary four-week rule.
historical_exposure: December was withheld from current modeling worker, but pooled full-history quantity summaries were shown to an earlier project AI session. First frozen December-specific scoring here is not claimed globally pristine untouched.
parent_acceptance: No invented complete_daily_sales=true or authenticated typed execution/acceptance records. Broader parent verification/delivery/recording gates remain separate.
evaluation_limit: One primary outcome release/evaluation; preserve pre-release artifacts and both pass/fail result. Defect recheck cannot refit/reselect/tune.
